nom: Lancôme Advanced Génifique Eye Light Pearl De-puffing Eye Serum

segments.sensitive: One reviewer with very sensitive skin, after spending heavily trying other products, says this is the one eye serum that doesn't bother her skin while still helping with under-eye puffiness.
segments.dry: One reviewer whose skin has become drier with age reports the serum makes her under-eye area more plump and less saggy.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their late 50s to 70s report strong results — brighter, less puffy, less wrinkled eyes, sometimes visible the first morning — though one 66-year-old with dark circles was still undecided after a couple of months of use.

concerns.aging: Many reviewers report visibly softer fine lines and expression lines around the eyes, sometimes noticeable the first morning of use and sustained over years of regular application; a notable minority, however, say it did nothing for their wrinkles despite consistent use.
concerns.spots: Dark circles under the eyes show a similar split to puffiness: several reviewers report they've lightened or disappeared with regular, sometimes years-long use, while others, including one who tried it for a month, saw no change to their dark circles.
concerns.barrier: The large majority of reviewers describe the serum as soothing and cooling with no irritation, but a meaningful minority report reactions: burning immediately after application, itchy or heavy-feeling eyes, stinging if it gets into the eyes, and one reviewer who developed a stye twice that she attributes to the applicator.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers describe the serum as hydrating, particularly helpful when the eye area feels drier than usual, with no reviewer in this set reporting a drying effect.

aspects.libelle: Applicator can dispense too much product
Bonus lash and brow growth reported

extraits.titre: No improvement; pills around the eyes
extraits.texte: I've only been using it for about a month, and haven't noticed any change to my dark circles and bags. Also, once it dries, it "pills" horribly. If you use it along the lash line as it recommends, the pilling gets in your eyes and it's very irritating. And also, because of the pilling, you can't wear it under makeup. I will not be buying this again.

I used this product for three months. It was going great, until I woke up one day with a STYE. The small glands that line my waterline got plugged. I know it was the product because I tried to use it a couple months after my stye cleared. I ended up with a stye again. I just think that even when using the applicator on clean hands, then applying it to under eyes; still makes it unsanitary. Plus the price makes this product not worth it.

After applying this product a couple of times, my eyes started to feel heavy and itchy! It doesn't reduce eye bags or easy wrinkles! All it does is irritations! Some of Lancôme products are not effective but not causing irritation either! But this one is certainly a BAD one!

This was a game changer for my aging 57 year old eyes. I keep it in the refrigerator. Each night before bed I massage the cold stainless steal with the serum under my eyes and on my eye lids. The results started to show the first morning. My eyes were visibly brighter, less puffy, less wrinkles, and appeared less sunken in. I did not have any irritation in or around my eyes. I highly recommend!

This is my second bottle of this eye serum. I have terribly sensitive skin and have spent too much money on "trying" products. I have finally found one that doesn't bother my skin and does help with my under eye puffiness (I'm 70).
I have been using Advanced Génifique Yeux Light-Pearl for 5 years, with no more puffiness or dark spots under my eyes anymore. But it takes time to recover my skills in the very beginning.
I love using this product for my aging skin. My skin has gott Dry as I've aged and this makes my under eyes more plump and less saggy
